author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Silent Store Gap
challenge.description: A batch of till scan lines from the northern stores was silently dropped during last night's ingestion, causing the model to forecast zero demand for fresh produce. #reliability_ruth# argues that the ingestion pipeline must be fully automated to guarantee every store's data arrives on time, while #data_dave# is willing to accept a manual verification step to ensure data quality before it reaches the feature store.

output.content: The hand over from versioning to the feature store must be fully governed. I will not accept a data version moving to the feature store without a formal sign off. If a version reaches the feature store without that sign off, I refuse to approve the deployment. This is a hard line for our team. We need a strict gate where the data quality and lineage are verified before any new version is available to the models. There is no room for manual exceptions or informal approvals in this step. The audit trail must be complete and unbroken. If we cannot guarantee that formal review, we cannot move the data forward.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a strict requirement for formal sign-off and audit trails as a 'hard line' and states a refusal to approve deployments if this condition is not met, which characterizes a boundary.
